title: Paddle a clear kayak over Sand Harbor's granite boulders
supports: Nevada State Parks identifies Sand Harbor's clear water and granite formations and explicitly lists kayaking as a supported activity. The ACTIVE Viator product supplies a fully transparent kayak, guide, training and safety gear for a small-group paddle from Sand Harbor; four current or future schedule seasons were verified.
hidden_gem_rationale: Sand Harbor is one of Lake Tahoe's headline recreation sites; classified as non-gem. Clear-kayak paddling is a different action from Wayfinder's existing Sand Harbor swimming adventure.

title: Hike to Grewingk Glacier Lake across Kachemak Bay
supports: Alaska State Parks describes the 3.2-mile Glacier Lake Trail as a foot route ending on the open beaches of Grewingk Glacier Lake. The ACTIVE Viator product is an easy-to-moderate guided hike through Kachemak Bay State Park to the glacier lake; one current or future schedule season was verified.
hidden_gem_rationale: The water-accessed state-park trail is less prominent than Alaska's road-accessible glacier stops and is absent from Wayfinder; classified as a gem.
